title: Malaysian Satay Wrap
description: A flavorful Malaysian-inspired dish with tender chicken, crunchy vegetables, and a sweet peanut sauce. Serve in a crispy wrap for a satisfying snack.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. In a shallow dish, whisk together peanut sauce and 2 tablespoons water.
3. Add chicken to the peanut sauce mixture and toss to coat.
4. Grill chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
5. Meanwhile, prepare snap peas, carrots, and cucumber slices.
6. Warm dumpling wraps according to package instructions.
7. Assemble wraps by placing cooked chicken, vegetables, and a spoonful of peanut sauce onto each wrap.
